Banner.Description: I have over 3+ years of experience building enterprise-grade backend systems and APIs for the Core Banking domain. I specialize in developing scalable, reliable, and secure applications using Java, Spring Boot, and Microservices architecture. My work spans database migration, payments, and SWIFT integrations, ensuring performance, resilience, and compliance. I'm passionate about writing clean, maintainable, and test-driven code, following best engineering practices and continuous improvement.
AboutMe.Title: About Me
AboutMe.Paragraphs: In 3+ years of experience working in Core Banking systems, I have focused on Backend Development and Middleware Engineering. I love contributing my knowledge to modernize legacy systems and build scalable solutions that solve real business problems.

My capabilities also include database migration, payments modernization, designing microservices, optimizing system performance, and suggesting and executing ideas that add value to the platforms I am working on.
I also program things for my personal use, whether for hobby or utility, often experimenting with automation, APIs, and AI-powered tools.
Some of the technologies I have trained and worked with include (but are not limited to):

FeatureProjects.Title: My Projects
FeatureProjects.Label: Highlighted Project

FeatureProjects.Projects.Title: DB Migration (Ingres → PostgreSQL)
FeatureProjects.Projects.Description: Migration of mission-critical banking databases with real-time synchronization using Spring Boot and Apache Kafka. Achieved zero downtime, improved query performance, and reduced licensing cost.

FeatureProjects.Projects.Title: Payments Modernization
FeatureProjects.Projects.Description: Transformation of monolithic payment modules into microservices using Spring Boot. Built scheduled workflows that improved transaction processing from minutes to seconds.

FeatureProjects.Projects.Title: Credit Score APIs
FeatureProjects.Projects.Description: Creation of RESTful services to integrate external credit bureau systems. Enabled faster and more accurate customer evaluation within core banking workflows.

FeatureProjects.Projects.Title: IBM ITX Tool Replacement
FeatureProjects.Projects.Description: Re-engineered legacy ITX-based applications into modern Java solutions. Eliminated expensive licensed dependencies and improved maintainability using Spring Boot.

FeatureProjects.Projects.Title: SWIFT Message Processing
FeatureProjects.Projects.Description: Development of utilities for SWIFT MT message creation and parsing compliant with ISO 20022. Enabled secure international payment communication in banking systems.

OtherProjects.Title: More Projects

OtherProjects.Projects.Title: ForecastingAI
OtherProjects.Projects.Description: AI-powered forecasting application built using Spring Boot and Gemini AI API, deployed on AWS EC2. Generates intelligent predictions and automated email reports for insights.

OtherProjects.Projects.Title: Cloud Chat
OtherProjects.Projects.Description: Cross-platform chat application built using Flutter with Firebase backend. Supports authentication, real-time messaging, and cloud storage using Firestore.
